system.name: LoopTailor
system.one_liner: an end-to-end VSync regulator that decouples game rendering from the cloud pipeline and coordinates VSync timing with the client

components.name: Client
components.role: mobile device that displays rendered frames and decodes incoming video

components.name: Display
components.role: renders the final game frame to the player

components.name: Frame Decoding
components.role: decodes the video-encoded game frame received from the cloud

components.name: Network
components.role: carries user inputs to the cloud and encoded game frames back to the client

components.name: Cloud
components.role: cloud-side host running the mobile game inside a virtualized Android emulator

components.name: Host OS
components.role: host operating system on the cloud server that runs the Emulator

components.name: Emulator
components.role: virtual machine emulating an Android device to run the mobile game

components.name: Android
components.role: guest OS inside the Emulator where the game executes and renders frames

components.name: Input Injection
components.role: injects the client's user inputs into the guest Android system, triggering VSync1

components.name: Game Rendering
components.role: guest-side rendering stage that produces each game frame

components.name: Game Frame Interceptor
components.role: captures game frames directly from rendering and submits them to encoding, bypassing VSync2 and VSync3

components.name: Frame Encoding
components.role: encodes the captured game frame for network transmission, triggering VSync4

components.name: Remote VSync Coordinator
components.role: forecasts and synchronizes the remaining VSync events (VSync1, VSync4, VSync5) across the cloud and client

flows.what: injected input driving the guest game

content.key_idea: LoopTailor inserts a Game Frame Interceptor to capture frames early (bypassing two VSyncs) and a Remote VSync Coordinator to synchronize the remaining VSync events between the cloud pipeline and the client.
content.reading_order: a round trip from Client through Network into the Cloud's Host OS/Emulator/Android stack, through Input Injection, Game Rendering, and the Interceptor, then back to the Client

evidence: Figure 2 shows the architectural overview of LoopTailor, which streamlines the interactive loop of X-MCG
Game Frame Interceptor which extracts and reroutes game frames to bypass unnecessary VSyncs (VSync2 and VSync3)
Remote VSync Coordinator which coordinates ahead of time the remaining VSyncs (VSync1, VSync4, and VSync5)

summary: LoopTailor is an end-to-end VSync regulator that streamlines mobile cloud gaming's interactive loop by decoupling game rendering from the cloud pipeline and coordinating VSync timing directly with the client. Figure 2 traces one round trip of that loop: a Client sends User Inputs over the Network to a cloud Host OS running an Android Emulator, where Input Injection (VSync1) feeds Game Rendering. LoopTailor's Game Frame Interceptor captures the rendered frame directly and submits it to Frame Encoding (VSync4), bypassing the VSync2/VSync3 stages a generic pipeline would need. The encoded frame travels back over the Network to the Client, which decodes it and composites it (Layer Composition, VSync5) for Display. A Remote VSync Coordinator, shown alongside the pipeline, synchronizes the three remaining VSync events between cloud and client.
summary_zh: 图2展示LoopTailor循环：输入经网络触发云端渲染，Interceptor截帧后提交编码跳过VSync2/VSync3，帧送回客户端解码显示，Coordinator协调剩余VSync事件。
